categories.main_business_segments: Inner Mongolia Baotou Steel Union Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the steel industry, engaging in mining, beneficiation, coking, sintering, pelletizing, ironmaking, steelmaking, and rolling processes. The company produces and sells steel products including hot-rolled and cold-rolled coils, galvanized steel, medium-thick plates, seamless pipes, heavy rails, profiles, and construction steel. It also develops and sells rare earth concentrates and fluorite concentrates, serving industries such as metallurgy, chemical, automotive, construction, railways, home appliances, wind power, and machinery manufacturing. Additionally, the company is involved in coal coking and chemical products production and sales, as well as steel production technology consulting and automotive freight transportation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced steel production technologies including CSP, wide and thick plate production lines, hot and cold rolling, continuous annealing, galvanizing, and electric steel refining. It has developed rare earth steel materials with over 50 years of R&D, employing mold casting and continuous casting processes. The company also implements high-end manufacturing upgrades such as low-carbon annealing furnace upgrades and RH refining furnace construction. It emphasizes digital and intelligent manufacturing with industrial robots, centralized control systems, and smart equipment projects. Green and low-carbon technologies are integrated, including energy efficiency projects, waste heat recovery, and ultra-low emission retrofits.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industries in infrastructure, railways, real estate, automotive, home appliances, wind power, machinery manufacturing, high-pressure boilers, petrochemicals, and strategic national projects. The company serves major domestic clients including central enterprises and regional companies, and exports products to developed countries in Europe, America, Korea, Japan, as well as countries along the Belt and Road Initiative in Asia, the Middle East, South America, and Africa. It has established strategic partnerships with automotive OEMs and leading enterprises in home appliances and railways.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Inner Mongolia, China, with its headquarters in Baotou City. It has a nationwide marketing network covering North China, Northeast China, East China, Central South China, Southwest China, and Northwest China, plus local spot sales centers. Internationally, it exports to Europe, America, Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, South America, Africa, and other Belt and Road countries. It benefits from proximity to coal-rich Shanxi and Shaanxi provinces and neighboring Mongolia and Russia, leveraging its strategic location in northern China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Inner Mongolia Baotou Steel Union Co., Ltd. operates across the upstream to downstream steel supply chain. It controls upstream mining and beneficiation of iron ore, rare earth, and fluorite resources, midstream coke production, sintering, pelletizing, ironmaking, and steelmaking, and downstream rolling and processing of steel products. It also integrates coal coking chemical production and provides steel production technology consulting and logistics services, positioning itself as a vertically integrated steel producer with resource development and product manufacturing capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on high-quality development with strategic priorities on optimizing product structure towards 'high-quality boutique steel + series of rare earth steels.' It emphasizes R&D in high-performance automotive steel, rare earth steel materials, and green low-carbon steel products. Innovation efforts include developing 60 new products, expanding rare earth steel varieties, and advancing digital transformation with intelligent manufacturing and industrial robots. It invests over 5% of revenue in R&D, builds national and provincial research platforms, and accelerates technology commercialization in areas like hydrogen metallurgy, energy efficiency, and rare earth material applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of steel products, rare earth concentrates, and chemical products. The company employs direct sales and distribution channels, with payment terms mostly on a prepayment basis, allowing some strategic customers credit periods. It also earns income from leasing land and equipment, providing technical consulting services, and receiving government subsidies. Investment income from equity investments and financial assets contributes additionally to revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as the largest steel listed company in western China with a leading role in rare earth steel new materials. It is one of China's top five steel rail producers and a major seamless pipe manufacturer with comprehensive product specifications. Its unique resource base at the world-renowned Bayan Obo mine provides a competitive advantage in rare earth steel materials. The company competes with other large Chinese steel producers and rare earth material suppliers, focusing on high-end, green, and intelligent steel products to differentiate itself.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 68.09 billion, a slight decrease of 3.51% year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 264.63 million, down 48.64%. Total assets reached RMB 155.13 billion, up 2.21%, with net assets of RMB 51.91 billion. The company maintains stable production with 14.21 million tons of iron and 14.99 million tons of steel produced. It has a workforce of over 25,000 employees and continues to invest heavily in R&D and capital expenditures to support growth and transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company leverages its unique resource advantage of the world's largest rare earth mine to produce rare earth steel materials that are stronger, tougher, and more durable. It emphasizes high-end, green, and intelligent steel products tailored for strategic industries such as automotive, railways, and wind power. Its vertically integrated production system ensures quality control and cost efficiency. The company also focuses on digital transformation and environmental sustainability, positioning itself as a leading supplier of premium rare earth steel new materials with strong brand recognition and technological innovation.
